title: Act on the Establishment and Operation of the National Institute of Ecology
title_original: 국립생태원의 설립 및 운영에 관한 법률
full_text:
ACT ON THE ESTABLISHMENT AND OPERATION OF THE NATIONAL INSTITUTE OF ECOLOGY

Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Act is to conserve the environment and foster proper environmental awareness by establishing the National Institute of Ecology and providing for its operation and other matters, thereby systematically conducting surveys, research, exhibitions, public education, etc. concerning ecology and ecosystems.

Article 2 (Legal Personality)
The National Institute of Ecology shall be a legal entity.

Article 3 (Registration of Establishment)
(1) The National Institute of Ecology shall be established upon registration of its establishment at the location of its principal office.
(2) The matters to be registered under paragraph (1) shall be as follows:
1. Purposes;
2. Name;
3. Locations of its principal office and affiliated institutions;
4. Names and addresses of officers;
5. Method of public notice.

Article 4 (Articles of Incorporation)
(1) The articles of incorporation of the National Institute of Ecology shall include the following matters:
1. Purposes;
2. Name;
3. Principal office;
4. Duties and the execution thereof;
5. Property and accounting;
6. Board of directors;
7. Officers and employees;
8. Amendment of the articles of incorporation;
9. Dissolution;
10. Method of public notice;
11. Affiliated institutions;
12. Matters required by this Act to be prescribed by the articles of incorporation;
13. Other matters concerning the operation of the National Institute of Ecology prescribed by Presidential Decree.
(2) Where the National Institute of Ecology intends to amend its articles of incorporation, it shall obtain authorization from the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment. <Amended on October 1, 2025>

Article 5 (Activities)
(1) The National Institute of Ecology shall carry out the following activities: <Amended on June 12, 2018; October 1, 2025>
1. Surveys, research, and evaluation concerning ecology;
2. Research on observation of ecosystem changes, adaptation thereto, etc.;
3. Observation of changes in global ecology by climate zone and research on adaptation to extreme climates;
4. Research and technology development projects concerning ecosystem restoration;
5. Research on the management of ecological risks posed by ecosystem-disturbing organisms (meaning ecosystem-disturbing organisms under Article 2, subparagraph 8 of the Act on the Conservation and Use of Biological Diversity) and living modified organisms (meaning living modified organisms under Article 2, subparagraph 2 of the Act on Transboundary Movement, Etc. of Living Modified Organisms);
6. Research on the classification, evaluation, and methods of continued use of services provided by ecosystems (meaning the benefits that the existence and functions of ecosystems, such as ecosystem cycles and the purification of pollutants, contribute to the survival of living organisms, including humans);
7. Development and operation of facilities for ecology-related exhibitions, hands-on experiences, and publicity concerning plants, animals, etc.;
8. Training of ecology specialists and development and operation of educational programs;
9. Exchange and cooperation with domestic and foreign ecology-related research institutions, etc., and projects to establish and operate ecosystem information networks;
10. Projects to revitalize local economies, including the promotion of ecotourism (meaning ecotourism under Article 41 of the Natural Environment Conservation Act) and income-generating projects in the relevant areas;
11. Projects for the conservation, propagation, and restoration of endangered wildlife;
12. Projects delegated under relevant statutes and regulations and projects entrusted by the State, local governments, or other institutions for ecosystem surveys, research, policy support, etc.;
13. Projects that the National Institute of Ecology may carry out under other statutes and regulations;
14. Duties incidental to the activities under subparagraphs 1 through 13 that are prescribed by the articles of incorporation;
15. Other projects deemed necessary by the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment to achieve the purposes for which the National Institute of Ecology was established.
(2) Where necessary, the National Institute of Ecology may carry out any activity under the subparagraphs of paragraph (1) outside the Republic of Korea.

Article 5-2 (Establishment of the Endangered Species Restoration Center)
(1) The Endangered Species Restoration Center (hereinafter referred to as the "Restoration Center") shall be established within the National Institute of Ecology to systematically promote activities for the conservation of endangered wildlife.
(2) The Restoration Center shall perform the following functions:
1. Formulating and implementing medium- and long-term research plans for endangered wildlife;
2. Projects concerning the development of conservation, propagation, and restoration technologies and support for their practical application;
3. Analysis and evaluation of the results of endangered wildlife restoration projects;
4. Development and operation of educational programs on endangered wildlife;
5. Other projects prescribed by the articles of incorporation.

Article 6 (Officers)
(1) The National Institute of Ecology shall have, as its officers, not more than 15 directors, including one President, and one auditor.
(2) The President and five directors shall serve full-time, and the other officers shall serve on a non-full-time basis.
(3) The President shall be appointed by the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment from among multiple candidates recommended by the Officer Recommendation Committee under Article 29 of the Act on the Management of Public Institutions (hereinafter referred to as the "Officer Recommendation Committee" in this Article). <Amended on October 1, 2025>
(4) Full-time directors shall be appointed by the President as prescribed by the articles of incorporation, and non-full-time directors shall be appointed by the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment. <Amended on October 1, 2025>
(5) The auditor shall be appointed by the Minister of Economy and Finance from among multiple candidates recommended by the Officer Recommendation Committee.

Article 7 (Duties of Officers)
(1) The President shall represent the National Institute of Ecology, oversee its affairs, and direct and supervise its employees.
(2) Full-time directors shall be responsible for their respective portions of the affairs of the National Institute of Ecology as prescribed by the articles of incorporation. Where the President is unable to perform his or her duties due to unavoidable circumstances, full-time directors shall act on the President's behalf in the order prescribed by the articles of incorporation.
(3) Directors shall deliberate on matters submitted to the board of directors and participate in its resolutions.
(4) The auditor shall audit the affairs and accounts of the National Institute of Ecology, prepare a comprehensive audit report each year, and submit it to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment and the board of directors. <Amended on October 1, 2025>

Article 8 (Terms of Office of Officers)
(1) The term of office of the President shall be three years, and the President may be reappointed for successive one-year terms.
(2) The terms of office of directors and the auditor shall be two years, and they may be reappointed for successive one-year terms.
(3) The term of office of an officer newly selected due to the resignation, etc. of an officer shall begin anew.

Article 9 (Disqualification of Officers, etc.)
(1) None of the following persons may become an officer of the National Institute of Ecology:
1. A person falling under any subparagraph of Article 33 of the State Public Officials Act;
2. A person for whom three years have not elapsed since dismissal under paragraph (4).
(2) Where an officer comes to fall under any subparagraph of paragraph (1), or is found to have fallen thereunder at the time of appointment, the officer shall automatically retire from office.
(3) Acts in which an officer who has retired under paragraph (2) participated before retirement shall not lose their effect.
(4) Where the President falls under any of the following subparagraphs, the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment may dismiss the President. Where a full-time director falls under any of the following subparagraphs (excluding subparagraph 4), the Minister may recommend that the President dismiss that director: <Amended on October 1, 2025>
1. Where the officer violates this Act, an order issued under this Act, or the articles of incorporation;
2. Where the officer causes impediments to the operation of the National Institute of Ecology through accounting irregularities, intent, or gross negligence;
3. Where the performance of duties becomes extremely difficult or impossible due to a physical or mental disability;
4. Where performance is poor according to the results of an operational evaluation under Article 25 (1).

Article 10 (Restrictions on Concurrent Employment of Officers and Employees)
(1) Full-time officers and employees of the National Institute of Ecology shall not engage in profit-making activities outside their official duties.
(2) Full-time officers of the National Institute of Ecology may concurrently engage in non-profit activities with permission from the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment, and employees of the National Institute of Ecology may do so with permission from the President. <Amended on October 1, 2025>

Article 11 (Board of Directors)
(1) The National Institute of Ecology shall have a board of directors to deliberate and resolve on the following matters:
1. Budgets and settlement of accounts;
2. Acquisition, disposal, and management of important property prescribed by the articles of incorporation;
3. Establishment and abolition of affiliated institutions and major organizational units prescribed by the articles of incorporation;
4. Medium- and long-term operation and development plans of the National Institute of Ecology;
5. Amendment of the articles of incorporation;
6. Enactment, amendment, and repeal of major regulations prescribed by the articles of incorporation;
7. Business plans;
8. Matters for which this Act or the articles of incorporation require a resolution of the board of directors;
9. Other matters that the President or the board of directors deems to require deliberation and resolution by the board of directors.
(2) The board of directors shall consist of the President and directors.
(3) The President shall convene the board of directors and serve as its chairperson.
(4) Except as otherwise provided in this Act and the articles of incorporation, meetings of the board of directors shall open with the attendance of a majority of its incumbent members and resolutions shall be adopted with the affirmative vote of a majority of the members present.
(5) Where necessary in relation to the auditor's duties, the auditor may attend meetings of the board of directors and state opinions.

Article 12 (Establishment of Affiliated Institutions)
Where necessary, the National Institute of Ecology may establish affiliated institutions after a resolution of the board of directors, as prescribed by the articles of incorporation.

Article 13 (Appointment and Dismissal of Employees, etc.)
(1) Employees of the National Institute of Ecology shall be appointed and dismissed by the President as prescribed by the articles of incorporation.
(2) A committee for recruiting employees shall be established to ensure fairness in employee appointments, and matters concerning its composition and operation shall be prescribed by the articles of incorporation.

Article 14 (Appointment of Agents)
The President may appoint, from among officers or employees, agents authorized to perform all judicial and extrajudicial acts in connection with the affairs of the National Institute of Ecology.

Article 15 (Financial Resources for Operation)
The National Institute of Ecology shall be operated with contributions or subsidies under Article 16, donations under Article 17, borrowings under Article 18, proceeds under Article 20, and other revenue.

Article 16 (Contributions or Subsidies)
The State may make contributions or provide subsidies, within budgetary limits, to cover expenses incurred in the activities and operation of the National Institute of Ecology, such as personnel expenses, project expenses, and facility expenses.

Article 17 (Acceptance of Donations)
(1) Notwithstanding the Act on Collection and Use of Donations, the National Institute of Ecology may accept donations of money or goods from corporations, organizations, individuals, and others.
(2) The National Institute of Ecology shall manage donations accepted under paragraph (1) in a separate account.

Article 18 (Borrowings)
The National Institute of Ecology may borrow funds with the approval of the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment when necessary for its operation. <Amended on October 1, 2025>

Article 19 (Support for Development of the Area Where the Institute Is Located)
The Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment may provide support, if necessary, for the mutually beneficial development of the National Institute of Ecology and the area in which its principal office is located. <Amended on October 1, 2025>

Article 20 (Revenue-Generating Activities, Etc.)
(1) The National Institute of Ecology may engage in revenue-generating activities, as prescribed by Presidential Decree, to the extent that such activities do not hinder the performance of its activities under Article 5.
(2) The proceeds from revenue-generating activities under paragraph (1) shall be used as financial resources for the operation of the National Institute of Ecology.

Article 21 (Business Year)
The business year of the National Institute of Ecology shall correspond to the fiscal year of the Government.

Article 22 (Submission of Business Plans, Etc.)
The President shall, as prescribed by Presidential Decree, prepare and submit a business plan and a budget before the beginning of each business year and obtain approval from the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment. The same shall apply when the President intends to amend them. <Amended on October 1, 2025>

Article 23 (Submission of Statements of Settlement of Accounts)
The President shall, as prescribed by Presidential Decree, submit to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment, within two months after the end of each fiscal year, a report stating the performance of activities during that fiscal year and a statement of settlement of revenue and expenditure that has been audited by a certified public accountant (including an accounting corporation under Article 23 of the Certified Public Accountant Act) and subsequently approved by a resolution of the board of directors. <Amended on October 1, 2025>

Article 24 (Disposition of Surplus)
The National Institute of Ecology shall first apply the surplus from each fiscal year to the repayment of debts and shall carry over any remaining surplus to the following fiscal year or use it to carry out its activities.

Article 25 (Evaluation of and Guidance on Operations)
(1) The Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment shall evaluate the operations of the National Institute of Ecology, as prescribed by Presidential Decree, and formulate necessary measures based on the results. <Amended on October 1, 2025>
(2) The criteria for evaluating operations under paragraph (1) shall include the management status of the National Institute of Ecology, the results of projects to promote ecosystem research activities, and services to the public relating to ecosystems.
(3) Matters necessary for detailed criteria and procedures for evaluating operations under paragraphs (1) and (2), and other relevant matters, shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 26 (Entry and Inspection, Etc.)
(1) The Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment may have public officials under his or her authority enter the National Institute of Ecology to inspect its activities, accounts, and assets, or may order the National Institute of Ecology to submit necessary materials. <Amended on October 1, 2025>
(2) If any unlawful or improper matter is found as a result of an inspection or the submission of materials under paragraph (1), the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment may order the National Institute of Ecology to rectify it or take other necessary measures. <Amended on October 1, 2025>

Article 27 (Cooperation in Activities and Conclusion of Agreements)
(1) The National Institute of Ecology may cooperate with universities, research institutions, and other organizations in Korea and abroad to efficiently conduct research, exhibition, and educational activities.
(2) When necessary to perform the activities under Article 5, the President may conclude agreements with universities, research institutions, and other organizations in Korea and abroad concerning projects to support personnel, research, exhibitions, and education.

Article 28 (Secondment of Public Officials, Etc.)
(1) When necessary to perform his or her duties, the President may, through the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment, request the secondment of personnel from State agencies, local governments, public institutions, educational institutions, or research institutions (hereinafter referred to as "public institutions, etc."). <Amended on October 1, 2025>
(2) Public institutions, etc. that receive a request under paragraph (1) may second their employees.
(3) A person seconded to the National Institute of Ecology under paragraph (2) shall not suffer any disadvantage in his or her status, including personnel management or remuneration, on account of the secondment.

Article 29 (Duty to Maintain Confidentiality)
Officers and employees of the National Institute of Ecology, persons seconded to the National Institute of Ecology under Article 28, and persons who formerly held such positions shall not divulge or misappropriate confidential information learned in the course of their duties.

Article 30 (Prohibition on the Use of Similar Names)
No person other than the National Institute of Ecology established under this Act shall use the name "National Institute of Ecology" or any similar name.

Article 31 (Application Mutatis Mutandis of the Civil Act)
Except as otherwise provided in this Act, the provisions of the Civil Act concerning incorporated foundations shall apply mutatis mutandis to the National Institute of Ecology.

Article 32 (Deemed Public Officials for Purposes of Applying Penalty Provisions)
Officers and employees of the National Institute of Ecology (including persons seconded to the National Institute of Ecology under Article 28) shall be deemed public officials for purposes of applying Articles 129 through 132 of the Criminal Act.

Article 33 (Penalty Provisions)
A person who divulges or misappropriates confidential information learned in the course of his or her duties in violation of Article 29 shall be punished by imprisonment for not more than two years or by a fine not exceeding 20 million won. <Amended on March 18, 2014>

Article 34 (Administrative Fines)
(1) A person who falls under any of the following subparagraphs shall be subject to an administrative fine not exceeding 5 million won:
1. A person who refuses, obstructs, or evades an inspection under Article 26 (1), or fails to submit materials or submits false materials;
2. A person who uses the name "National Institute of Ecology" or any similar name in violation of Article 30.
(2) Administrative fines under paragraph (1) shall be imposed and collected by the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment, as prescribed by Presidential Decree. <Amended on October 1, 2025>

ADDENDA <Act No. 11880, June 12, 2013>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Act shall enter into force three months after the date of its promulgation: Provided, That Articles 2 through 4 and 8 of the Addenda shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

Article 2 (Preparations for Establishment)
(1) The Minister of Environment shall constitute and operate the National Institute of Ecology Establishment Committee (hereinafter referred to as the "Establishment Committee") within one month from the date of promulgation of this Act to handle affairs concerning the establishment of the National Institute of Ecology.
(2) The Establishment Committee shall consist of not more than 10 establishment members commissioned by the Minister of Environment, and the Vice Minister of Environment shall serve as its chairperson.
(3) The Establishment Committee shall prepare the articles of incorporation of the National Institute of Ecology, affix names and seals or signatures thereto, and obtain authorization from the Minister of Environment.
(4) The Establishment Committee shall complete the registration of establishment of the National Institute of Ecology in the joint names of the establishment members by the date this Act enters into force.
(5) The Establishment Committee shall transfer its affairs to the President without delay after the registration of establishment.
(6) When the transfer of affairs under paragraph (5) is completed, the Establishment Committee shall be deemed dissolved, and its members shall be deemed released from their commissions.

[Enforcement Date: June 12, 2013]

Article 3 (Appointment of Officers at the Time of Establishment)
Notwithstanding Article 6, the first officers of the National Institute of Ecology appointed after this Act enters into force shall be appointed by the Minister of Environment from among multiple candidates recommended by the Establishment Committee.

[Enforcement Date: June 12, 2013]

Article 4 (Establishment Expenses)
The State shall bear the expenses incurred in establishing the National Institute of Ecology.

[Enforcement Date: June 12, 2013]

Article 5 (Transfer of Goods, Etc. without Consideration)
Notwithstanding the Commodity Management Act and the Cultural Heritage Protection Act, the State shall transfer, without consideration, to the National Institute of Ecology the goods and cultural heritage (limited to cultural heritage designated as endangered wildlife under the Wildlife Protection and Management Act) managed by the National Institute of Ecology Incorporation Promotion Team, which was established within the Ministry of Environment before this Act enters into force to promote the incorporation of the National Institute of Ecology: Provided, That, in the case of goods, prior consultation shall be held with the Minister of Economy and Finance.

Article 6 (Succession to Rights and Obligations)
(1) The National Institute of Ecology established under this Act shall comprehensively succeed to the rights and obligations of the National Institute of Ecology Incorporation Promotion Team.
(2) The name of the National Institute of Ecology Incorporation Promotion Team appearing in registers or other public records concerning the rights and obligations to which the National Institute of Ecology comprehensively succeeds under paragraph (1) shall be deemed the name of the National Institute of Ecology.

Article 7 (Budget at the Time of Establishment)
(1) Until its budget at the time of establishment is finalized, the National Institute of Ecology established under this Act may execute the budget formerly under the jurisdiction of the National Institute of Ecology Incorporation Promotion Team in accordance with previous practice.
(2) Once the budget of the National Institute of Ecology is adopted, expenditures made under paragraph (1) shall be deemed to have been made under the adopted budget.

Article 8 (Transitional Measures concerning Budget Formulation)
The Establishment Committee may prepare the budget document of the National Institute of Ecology for the first business year commencing after the establishment of the National Institute of Ecology.

[Enforcement Date: June 12, 2013]

Article 9 (Transitional Measures concerning the Enforcement Date of the Act on Transboundary Movement, Etc. of Living Modified Organisms)
Until December 11, 2013, "Article 2, subparagraph 2 of the Act on Transboundary Movement, Etc. of Living Modified Organisms" in Article 5, subparagraph 5 shall be construed as "Article 2, subparagraph 1 of the Act on Transboundary Movement, Etc. of Living Modified Organisms".

ADDENDA <Act No. 12453, March 18, 2014>

This Act shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

ADDENDA <Act No. 15650, June 12, 2018>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Act shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

Article 2 (Succession to Rights and Obligations)
The National Institute of Ecology shall comprehensively succeed to the rights and obligations of the National Endangered Species Restoration Center Construction Promotion Team, which was previously established within the Ministry of Environment to promote the construction of the Restoration Center.

ADDENDA (Government Organization Act) <Act No. 21065, October 1, 2025>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Act shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation: Provided, That the portions amending Acts promulgated before this Act enters into force but whose enforcement dates have not yet arrived, among the Acts amended under Article 7 of the Addenda, shall enter into force on the respective enforcement dates of those Acts, and the following amended provisions shall enter into force on the dates specified in the respective subparagraphs:
1. The amended provisions specified in the following items shall enter into force on January 2, 2026: Provided, That the portions amending Acts promulgated before the enforcement date specified in the main clause but which have not yet entered into force as of that date, among the Acts amended under Article 7 of the Addenda (limited to the portions relating to the amended provisions specified in items (a) and (b)), shall enter into force on the respective enforcement dates of those Acts:
  (a) The amended provisions of Article 19 (4), Article 23, Article 29 (1) 1, and Article 30;
  (b) The amended provisions of Article 12 (2), Article 19 (3), Article 22, and the proviso to Article 29 (2) (limited to the portions concerning the Minister of Finance and Economy and the Ministry of Finance and Economy);
  (c) The Acts amended under Article 7 of the Addenda (limited to the portions relating to the amended provisions specified in items (a) and (b)).
2. Omitted.

Articles 2 through 6 Omitted.

Article 7 (Amendments to Other Acts)
(1) through (325) Omitted.

(326) The Act on the Establishment and Operation of the National Institute of Ecology is partially amended as follows:

In Article 4 (2), Article 5 (1) 15, Article 6 (3) and (4), Article 7 (4), the portion other than the subparagraphs of Article 9 (4), Article 10 (2), Article 18, Article 19, the former part of Article 22, Article 23, Article 25 (1), Article 26 (1) and (2), Article 28 (1), and Article 34 (2), "Minister of Environment" shall be replaced by "Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment" in each occurrence.

In Article 6 (5), "Minister of Economy and Finance" shall be replaced by "Minister of Finance and Economy".

(327) through (626) Omitted.

Article 8 Omitted.
